grants.title: Tilskudd til friluftslivsaktivitet
grants.amount_note: The grant page gives no maximum amount, so you cannot tell if 60000 NOK is allowed. Ask the grant provider before you apply.
grants.why_qualifies: Your project is an organised outdoor activity for children, with hiking, campfire and canoe trips. The grant supports organised friluftsliv activities that increase participation, and your club is a registered voluntary organisation.
attachments: The grant page lists no required attachments. Check the application form to see if you need any.
steps: Read the grant page and the Miljødirektoratet application portal.
Write a short description of your outdoor activity days for children aged 6-12.
Make a budget for the 60000 NOK you want to apply for.
Ask the grant provider if 60000 NOK is within the maximum amount.
Send one application in the electronic form on the Miljødirektoratet portal.
Confirm the deadline on the grant page before you apply.
